summary: John's 6th-great-grand-aunt (sister of Ensign Thomas); founder with her husband of Plymouth's Davenport clan.
bio: Charity Lamoreux (1759-1848), sister of Ensign Thomas, married her first cousin Thomas Davenport (1749-1812); they came to Plymouth in 1794. Their sons were the 'Davenport congress'. Their daughters Phoebe (m. John Pringle) and Hannah (m. Jacob Gould; mother of Charity Gould Pringle) married into the Pringles.
